svg.title: Snapshots wireframe
svg.text: Stored plan state with label and date.
Ordered newest first. Stored plan state and progress, never a reference to changing data.
Deltas are computed by the backend from the two stored snapshots.
The original plan and later snapshots stay intact.
Every snapshot has a label and a creation date and is ordered newest first.
Comparison shows net worth and FI metrics from both snapshots with deltas.
Restoring creates a new plan or revision. The source plan and any later snapshots stay unchanged.
A snapshot stores plan state, progress points, and the last completed result id, so it is reproducible.
